nodes.name: 01-llm-layer.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the LLM multi-protocol abstraction layer: design goals, the rationale for building in-house vs LiteLLM, the unified data model, four key protocol differences (system-message placement, tool-call message format, usage fields, streaming event structure), GLM integration details with 2026 model-selection guidance, and how to add a new provider.
nodes.languageNotes: Compares three LLM protocols (OpenAI/Anthropic/GLM) and justifies a custom adapter over LiteLLM, with GLM as the primary integration target in 2026.

nodes.name: 02-agent-graph.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for LangGraph-based agent orchestration: why LangGraph, the hand-written ReAct loop design with three core components and agent state, why a custom ReAct was chosen over create_react_agent, short-term memory integration, the tool system, and infinite-loop prevention.

nodes.name: 03-memory.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the three-tier memory system (short-term checkpointer, long-term store, and conversation log), how memories are injected into the dialogue, and how long-term memory differs from the user profile.

nodes.name: 04-mcp.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration: both directions (client connecting external tools and server exposing the agent's own tools), external server configuration, the tool registry as the single source of truth, and the version strategy.

nodes.name: 05-skills.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the Skill system: why skills exist, their structure, declarative decorator-style usage, the workflow, the built-in math_assistant example, the relationship between Skill, Tool, and MCP, and how to add a new skill.

nodes.name: 06-user-profile.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the user-profile subsystem built on a graph database: the rationale for graph DB, the data model (nodes and relationships), the API, graceful degradation, Cypher query examples, and collaboration with long-term memory.

nodes.name: 07-a2a.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol on a2a-sdk 1.1.x / v1.0: protocol essentials, the endpoints this agent exposes, both directions (server exposing the agent and client calling external agents), multi-agent collaboration scenarios, and the Agent Card.

nodes.name: 08-hermes-evolution.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for Hermes self-evolution: two core capabilities (automatic memory/profile learning, and reflection plus prompt self-optimization), prompt version management, API endpoints, and config switches.

nodes.name: 09-auth-tenant.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for user authentication and multi-tenancy: JWT auth mechanism, endpoints, and config switches; multi-tenant isolation with an unforgeable tenant_id; Redis sliding-window rate limiting with exemptions; and why the core layers need no changes for these concerns.
nodes.languageNotes: Treats the unforgeable server-derived tenant_id as the central security invariant that lets auth/tenancy live entirely in middleware without touching core agent layers.

nodes.name: 10-rag-enterprise.md
nodes.summary: Reference doc for the RAG knowledge base and enterprise capabilities: the retrieval-augmented generation pipeline reusing existing infrastructure, file/image upload with security, usage statistics with cost estimation, observability via /metrics, and a full enterprise-capability comparison.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Index page for the docs/02-modules/ reference manual, listing the ten per-subsystem module docs (LLM layer, agent graph, memory, MCP, skills, user profile, A2A, Hermes evolution, auth/tenancy, RAG) with their Phase and completion status.
nodes.languageNotes: Source doc is in Chinese; the index table maps each subsystem to its detailed module doc and delivery Phase.
